title: Guest Room/bathroom near Nashville
description:
Pleasant View guest room and bathroom in a family friendly neighborhood. Centrally located between Nashville and Clarksville. You will have access to many amenities including: WIFI, TV, WII, Coffee Maker, mini fridge, board games, exercise bike, desk, couch sectional, books, Blue-ray player, and more. You will sleep in a peaceful Queen size bed and have private access to a bathroom for your convenience.

The space
You may park in the driveway, but please do not block the garage.

Guest access
The front door is the entrance. The room and bathroom are upstairs. No access to backyard or downstairs permitted.

During your stay
Message on the Airbnb app if you need assistance.
